title: EM
description: The war against humanity have shifted in the favor the Machines. Play as the protagonist Rockie and use Electro-Magnetic combat to battle the Machine bosses.For fans of Yakuza style combat and boss fights, this is the game for you!Key FeaturesCombat Switching: Switch between four different fighting styles instantaneously during battle. Each style has it's own advantage and disadvantage in battle.Diverse Enemy Types: Each enemy opponent will have a unique fighting style ranging for Boxing, Martial Arts and Capoeira.
description_short: EM is a fast-paced, hard hitting 3D fighter featuring Electro-Magnetic combat. To win the war against the machines, you as an elite fighter will go fist to fist on a mission to annihilate them all!
